header.name: Motion Design and Graphics
header.description:
This course introduces students to: 
(i) Define functions and significant of Motion Graphics
(ii) Introduction to the principles of motion graphics production.
(iii) The basic software/tools used in the manipulation and control of motion graphics.
(iv) Developing own a short visual story from a script.
prerequisites_desirable: Having basic knowadge of Adobe Graphical tool.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will understand the foundational principles underlying Motion Graphics.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will utilize the basic tools of Motion Graphics (After effects, Photoshop)

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to design their own project related Animated Logo and display assets.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to produce short animated visual story for a project.
